✗ non_deterministic_code: Script contains `Math.random()` which produces non-deterministic output. Renders may differ between frames or runs.
Fix: Use a seeded PRNG (e.g. a simple mulberry32) so renders are deterministic across frames.
✗ non_deterministic_code: Script contains `Date.now()` which produces non-deterministic output. Renders may differ between frames or runs.
Fix: Remove time-dependent code. Use GSAP timeline position instead of wall-clock time.
✗ non_deterministic_code: Script contains `performance.now()` which produces non-deterministic output. Renders may differ between frames or runs.
Fix: Remove time-dependent code. Use GSAP timeline position instead of wall-clock time.
✗ media_missing_id: <audio> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements — this audio will be SILENT in renders.
Fix: Add a unique id attribute: <audio id="my-audio" ...>
✗ invalid_parent_traversal_in_asset_path: Found 1 asset path(s) traversing above the project root with "../" (../../). Renders rewrite this against each sub-composition's source path, but Studio preview and other live consumers resolve against the project root and 404.
Fix: Use plain root-relative paths (e.g. "assets/...", "capture/...", "fonts/...") — compositions are served with the project root as their base URL, so paths must be root-relative, not relative to the compositions/ directory.
✗ requestanimationframe_in_composition: `requestAnimationFrame` runs on wall-clock time, not the GSAP timeline. It will not sync with frame capture and may cause flickering or missed frames during rendering.
Fix: Use GSAP tweens or onUpdate callbacks instead of requestAnimationFrame for animation logic.
⚠ studio_missing_editable_id: <audio data-start="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
Fix: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.
⚠ composition_file_too_large: This HTML composition file has 1134 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
Fix: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.
Continuing render despite lint issues. Use --strict to block errors.
